name: smhi
description: SMHI (Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute): look up places, get current weather, 10-day forecasts and recent observed weather, see active weather warnings, search SMHI's open-data catalog, download station observations from the open metobs API, and search or read knowledge-bank and news articles.

commands.name: search-places
commands.summary: Find places in Sweden by name. Returns the geonameid and lat/lon that the forecast and warning commands take.

params.name: query
params.description: Place name or its beginning, e.g. Uppsala

commands.name: get-current-weather
commands.summary: Get the current weather (temperature and weather symbol) for a place, by geonameid.

params.name: geonameid
params.description: GeoNames place id from search-places, e.g. 2673730 (Stockholm)

commands.name: get-forecast
commands.summary: Get the 10-day weather forecast for a place, by geonameid. Returns one entry per day with a summary, midday values and hourly data.

params.name: geonameid
params.description: GeoNames place id from search-places, e.g. 2666199 (Uppsala)

commands.name: get-recent-weather
commands.summary: Get the analysed/observed weather for the past hours at a place (MESAN analysis), by geonameid.

params.name: geonameid
params.description: GeoNames place id from search-places, e.g. 2666199

commands.name: get-place-warnings
commands.summary: Get the most severe active warnings and advisories (level, type and count) at a lat/lon coordinate.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 59.85

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 17.6333333

commands.name: get-national-warning-level
commands.summary: Get the most severe weather-warning level currently active anywhere in Sweden (e.g. YELLOW).

commands.name: list-warnings
commands.summary: List all active weather warnings and advisories in Sweden, with level, event type, area, time window and descriptions.

commands.name: search-open-data
commands.summary: Search SMHI's open-data catalog for datasets by keyword. Use query 'all' to list every dataset.

params.name: query
params.description: Search term, usually Swedish (e.g. temperatur, nederbörd), or 'all' for everything

commands.name: get-open-data-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one open-data catalog dataset, by its name slug (from search-open-data).

params.name: name
params.description: Dataset name slug from search-open-data

commands.name: list-observation-stations
commands.summary: List the meteorological observation stations that measure a parameter (metobs open API). Returns station keys for get-station-observations.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Metobs parameter id: 1 = air temperature, hourly instant value. Other ids are listed by the metobs API.

commands.name: get-latest-observations-all-stations
commands.summary: Get the latest-hour observed value of a parameter from every active station in one call.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Metobs parameter id, e.g. 1 = air temperature

commands.name: get-station
commands.summary: Get details for one observation station and parameter: owner, position history, active status and available data periods.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Metobs parameter id, e.g. 1 = air temperature

params.name: station
params.description: Station key from list-observation-stations, e.g. 97510 (Uppsala Aut)

commands.name: get-station-observations
commands.summary: Get observed values (timestamp in epoch ms, value, quality code) for one station, parameter and time period.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Metobs parameter id, e.g. 1 = air temperature

params.name: station
params.description: Station key, e.g. 97510

params.name: period
params.description: Time period: latest-hour, latest-day, or latest-months (last ~4 months)

commands.name: search-knowledge-bank
commands.summary: Search SMHI's knowledge bank (Kunskapsbanken) articles on meteorology, hydrology, oceanography and climate. Optionally filter by topic.

params.name: query
params.description: Search term, usually Swedish, e.g. åska

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic facet (Ämne), e.g. Meteorologi, Hydrologi, Oceanografi, Klimat, Forskning

params.name: startAtHit
params.description: Result offset (10 per page)

commands.name: get-knowledge-article
commands.summary: Read a knowledge-bank article, by topic and slug (from the search-knowledge-bank url /kunskapsbanken/{topic}/{slug}).

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic path segment, e.g. meteorologi, hydrologi, oceanografi, klimat

params.name: slug
params.description: Article slug, e.g. svenska-nederbordsrekord

commands.name: get-news-article
commands.summary: Read an SMHI news article, by slug (path segment after /nyheter/nyheter/).

params.name: slug
params.description: News article slug, e.g. 2026-10-08-wmo-el-nino-ar-fast-etablerad-och-blir-snabbt-starkare

notes: Workflow: search-places gives a geonameid plus lat/lon. Pass the geonameid to get-current-weather, get-forecast and get-recent-weather, and the lat/lon to get-place-warnings.

Wsymb2 / wSymb2 is SMHI's weather-symbol code: 1 = clear sky, 2 = nearly clear, and so on up to 27 (snow and thunder). Units: wind (ws, gust) in m/s, wind direction (wd) in degrees, humidity (r) in %, pressure (msl) in hPa, visibility (vis) in km, precipitation in mm. A value of '-' means not available.
Times are UTC ISO strings. In the forecast, localDate is local time, written with a Z suffix.
Metobs open API timestamps (date, from, to, updated) are epoch milliseconds. Quality codes: G = checked and approved, Y = suspect or aggregated, O = unchecked.
Metobs parameter 1 = air temperature (hourly instant value). Other parameter ids exist in the SMHI metobs API (https://opendata-download-metobs.smhi.se/api/version/latest.json).
Warning levels: MESSAGE (advisory), YELLOW, ORANGE, RED. NONE means no warning.
Knowledge-bank articles nested more than two levels deep (e.g. /kunskapsbanken/meteorologi/aska/olika-typer-av-aska) cannot be fetched with get-knowledge-article's topic/slug params.

Not covered: general site search (/sokresultat), the news listing and county warning polygons (backend-warnings-page/geo/counties). The first two render their results client-side through Sitevision AJAX routes whose response format was not captured; the county data is mostly polygon geometry.
